source: Knock model v6 (burn law phase 3, 2026-10-20; v5 burn law phase 2a, v4 knock calibration phase B): the parameter set of the map generator's knock replay, tau = scale * A * (OI/100)^on_exponent * (p/1 atm)^-pressure_exponent * exp(activation_k/T) / (1 - x_res)^dilution_exponent, integrated Livengood-Wu from IVC to the Wiebe burned fraction end_burn_fraction (or EVO) (ps/engine_cycle/knock.h), x_res = the end gas's residual mass fraction at IVC, the end gas isentropic from T_ivc - charge_heat_fraction * (T_ivc - T_intake), every replay at the burn law's own per-cycle burn angles (ps/engine_cycle/burn_law.h, law v3). The compiled defaults in ps/engine_cycle/knock_model.h equal this file entry by entry (tests/unit/test_knock_cal_turbo.cpp 'KCB knock model file'). Fit: least squares of theta_kl - measured spark over the envelope rows of the Toyota A25A (EPA NVFEL, 17 rows, NA, KV1-BC) and the Honda L15B7 on EPA Tier 3 E10 (EPA NVFEL, 15 rows, MAP 98-196 kPa) at MEASURED boundary conditions (trapped air = measured air, measured intake temperature, lambda and cam phases, exhaust reservoir at ambient), constrained to every A25A row within +-7.5 deg and the A25A mean within +-1.75 deg (KV1-BC's bands) and to the light-load no-knock rows (the model's knock limit at most 3 deg [AS] below min(measured spark, MBT)) of every EPA turbo package (tests/support/fixtures/epa_turbo/*_light_rows.json) and - new in v6 - of the A25A's own Tier 3 part-load rows with the EGR valve shut (tests/support/fixtures/burn_law/a25a_t3_part_rows.json, egr_shut: EGR inlet temperature < 180 degC [AS], 36 of 67 rows). The 31 rows with cooled external EGR flowing are reported, not constrained: the cycle model and the replay have no external EGR (out of scope, like the Mazda 2.5 T). Bands as v5 (declared 2026-10-19); the objective also carries KV1-BC's declared A25A mean band (1.75 deg): without it the descent ended at end fraction 0.90, k_h 0.15, scale 0.006542 with the A25A mean +2.10. Why v6: under burn law v3 the v5 set read every package 1-7 deg too knock-prone and the A25A part-load rows violated by up to 15 deg; of two candidate end-gas terms (an end-gas wall-heat fraction, and the charge-heat fraction below) only the charge-heat fraction lowered the objective (the wall-heat fraction stayed at 0 under coordinate descent). The measured ECU spark is the knock limit minus the OEM's own margin; like KV1-BC the fit treats measured spark as theta_kl with margin 0, so the calibrated model absorbs the OEM margin - an ECU's knock_margin_deg is margin BEYOND that OEM-equivalent limit. Held out: the envelope rows of the Honda L15B7 on Tier 2 E0 and of the Ford 2.7 EcoBoost (four packages); reported: Ford 1.6 EcoBoost, Mazda 2.5 T. The shipped point is a coordinate-descent minimum at the KCB neighbour steps. Decision note: vault PHYS-069 (v4), PHYS-079 (v5, v6), docs/data_formats/engine.md 'Knock limit'.

prefactor_s.source: [AS] Douaud & Eyzat 1978 (SAE 780080) via Heywood 1988 sec. 9.6.2, not verified locally

octane_index_k.source: [AS] OI = RON - K*(RON - MON); K 0.5 = the anti-knock index (R+M)/2. A pressure/temperature-dependent K (SAE 2012-01-1634) was considered and rejected: the test fuels' sensitivity S is 7.5-9, so the measured MAP trend would need K about -3

prefactor_scale.source: [M] fitted (see source); v2 1.26 at the literature n and B, v3 0.012, v4 0.004938, v5 0.006095

activation_k.source: [M] fitted; literature 3800 K, v3 5800 K, v4 6100 K, v5 6400 K

dilution_exponent.source: [M] fitted under the light-load no-knock constraint (the fit rows alone cannot identify it: residual fractions 0.03-0.10); v4 5.5, v5 4.0. Form: a residual/EGR dilution factor on the ignition rate as used in EGR knock-integral correlations (e.g. SAE 2012-01-0707, not verified locally); the value is EFFECTIVE - it also absorbs the model's residual heating of the end gas - and is not a chemical constant

end_burn_fraction.source: [M] fitted (v6; v5 0.75 [M], up to v4 0.90 [AS] 'past it the end gas left is too small to matter'). EFFECTIVE: the single-zone replay exposes the end gas to the bulk pressure

charge_heat_fraction.source: [M] fitted (knock model v6, burn law phase 3). The end gas starts at T_ivc - k (T_ivc - T_intake): the share of the generated charge's heating above the intake temperature (residual mixing, port and wall heat) the end gas does not carry. EFFECTIVE: the single-zone IVC state mixes the hot residual uniformly while the end gas at the cylinder periphery is the coldest charge, and the generator's charge is hotter than the spark-consistent one (P7c, vault PHYS-070); not a measured stratification
